rationale: The workflow performs multiple heavy Python-based specification generation steps (makeSpec) which likely involve significant file I/O and processing. Implementing a cache for the 'out' directory and the 'generated' directory (as indicated by the Makefile) can significantly reduce redundant computation on subsequent runs. I will use actions/cache@v4 to cache the output directories, keyed by the runner OS and the Makefile/lockfile to ensure cache invalidation when build logic changes.
